packageDescription.label: Origin Quests
packageDescription.summary: Heritages and the Origin Quests for the different character heritages

characterHeritages.label: Scavenger
characterHeritages.description: The narrow alleys and bustling streets of Freehaven are your home. You grew up scavenging what you could and selling what you had to. A week ago, you signed on to a contract guiding a noble through the blighted Sundered Lands.

characterHeritages.label: Ex-Soldier
characterHeritages.description: After refusing an order that would have lined a Syndicate captain's pockets, you were framed for theft and stripped of your rank. After that, you were easy to disappear.

characterHeritages.label: Refugee
characterHeritages.description: You fled the fall of Murmansk with nothing. Stateless and undocumented, you were exactly the kind of person the Syndicate preys on... there was nobody to report you missing.

characterHeritages.label: Steward
characterHeritages.description: You served a wealthy household in Svea until your employer fell into catastrophic debt with the Syndicate. When they came to collect, they took the staff along with the furniture.

zones.label: Grima
zones.description: An abandoned settlement on Aren Island. The air is thin and cold, and the old buildings have fallen into disrepair.
